_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#001.src: Ah, one of you adventurin' types, huh? We see a lot of you around here... Going in and out as you please. Must be a nice life.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#001.dst: Ah, encore un de ces aventuriers, hein? On en voit plein par ici... Vous allez et venez comme bon vous semble. Belle vie.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#001.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#002.src: Though, if you could spare some time, the town could use you-
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#002.dst: Mais si vous aviez un moment, la ville aurait bien besoin de vous-
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#002.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#003.src: Wait, already?! It's only been a day since last! How insatiable are they...?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#003.dst: Attendez, déjà?! Ça fait un jour à peine! Ils sont insatiables ou quoi...?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#003.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#004.src: THE UNDEAD HAVE OVERWHELMED THE GOLEMS! EVERY CITIZEN FOR THEMSELVES!!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#004.dst: LES MORTS-VIVANTS ONT SUBMERGÉ LES GOLEMS! SAUVE QUI PEUT!!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#004.speaker: Gelibord Guard

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#005.src: This is what I was talking about! We need your help with this! You Wynn folk are good at killing zombies, right?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#005.dst: Voilà de quoi je parlais! On a besoin de vous! Vous, les gens de Wynn, vous savez tuer les zombies, non?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#005.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#006.src: We need help with this! Defend the town with us!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#006.dst: On a besoin d'aide! Défendez la ville avec nous!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#006.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#007.src: The horde's retreating, but we have one citizen dead! Regroup at the square and prepare the pyres!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#007.dst: La horde recule, mais un citoyen est mort! Regroupez-vous sur la place et préparez les bûchers!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#007.speaker: Gelibord Guard

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#008.src: Check in with Burtur about the attack at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#008.dst: Voyez avec Burtur au sujet de l'attaque en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#009.src: Phew. That was a smaller horde, thankfully... Still, good thing you were there. That could have been worse.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#009.dst: Ouf. Heureusement, la horde était petite... Mais tant mieux que vous ayez été là. Ça aurait pu être pire.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#009.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#010.src: Still, c'mon now... We have to burn the bodies. Can't leave the job half-done.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#010.dst: Allez, venez... Il faut brûler les corps. On ne peut pas laisser le travail à moitié fait.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#010.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#011.src: It's a bit sacrilegious, but necessary to do right now- otherwise they just keep coming back, like they do across the ridge in Kander.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#011.dst: C'est un peu sacrilège, mais nécessaire pour l'instant- sinon ils reviennent encore et encore, comme de l'autre côté de la crête, à Kander.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#011.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#012.src: Since we don't live in a reeking, pockmarked plain, we have to burn the bodies so any dead don't turn right around against us.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#012.dst: Comme on ne vit pas dans une plaine puante et criblée de trous, on doit brûler les corps pour que nos morts ne se retournent pas contre nous.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#012.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#013.src: Say your goodbyes, all. Irahe will be missed. Step away from the pyre!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#013.dst: Faites vos adieux, tous. Irahe nous manquera. Écartez-vous du bûcher!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#013.speaker: Gelibord Guard

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#014.src: Some conspiracy theorists think that the Lazarus Pit is the issue. It's an urban legend, a well of water that can revive the dead.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#014.dst: Des complotistes pensent que le Puits de Lazarus est le problème. C'est une légende urbaine, un puits dont l'eau ranime les morts.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#014.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#015.src: Supposing that it's real, it would make some sense, at least- If it started feeding into the river or water tables, then we'd get the current goings-on.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#015.dst: S'il existe, ça se tiendrait, au moins- S'il s'était mis à alimenter la rivière ou les nappes, on aurait exactement ce qui se passe.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#015.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#016.src: Of course, no one knows where it is, since it's just rumors, but there's supposedly an "Order" of pit-keepers. Conveniently long dead, and buried in that small graveyard just north of here.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#016.dst: Bien sûr, personne ne sait où il est, ce ne sont que des rumeurs, mais il y aurait un "Ordre" de gardiens du puits. Morts depuis longtemps, comme par hasard, et enterrés dans le petit cimetière juste au nord.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#016.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#017.src: I'll stay back at the town square, in case the undead attack again. Give me a shout if you find something you aren't sure about.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#017.dst: Je reste sur la place, au cas où les morts-vivants reviendraient. Appelez-moi si vous trouvez quelque chose de douteux.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#017.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#018.src: Have you checked out that small graveyard north of here yet? Remember, you're looking for any clues about that Lazarus Pit "Order."
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#018.dst: Vous avez fouillé le petit cimetière au nord? N'oubliez pas, vous cherchez des indices sur cet "Ordre" du Puits de Lazarus.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#018.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#019.src: Find the body of the Order's mage in {p}'s graveyard at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#019.dst: Trouvez le corps du mage de l'Ordre dans le cimetière de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#020.src: Locate the chapel mentioned by the talisman, or return to Burtur for assistance.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#020.dst: Trouvez la chapelle mentionnée par le talisman, ou retournez voir Burtur pour de l'aide.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#021.src: Any luck searching out that chapel yet? The coordinates ought to be in your content book, right?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#021.dst: Alors, cette chapelle? Les coordonnées devraient être dans votre livre de contenu, non?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#021.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#022.src: Investigate the Order's chapel northwest of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#022.dst: Examinez la chapelle de l'Ordre au nord-ouest de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#023.src: Solve the crypt's riddle to 'bring the water of life anew' to the graves.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#023.dst: Résolvez l'énigme de la crypte pour "rendre l'eau de la vie" aux tombes.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#024.src: Perhaps you could use this water to revive some of the graves around the crypt...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#024.dst: Vous pourriez peut-être utiliser cette eau pour ranimer des tombes autour de la crypte...

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#025.src: Revive the people in the tombs with the Lazarus Water and complete their tasks.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#025.dst: Ranimez les occupants des tombes avec l'Eau de Lazarus et accomplissez leurs requêtes.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#026.src: Ugh. And who put YOU in charge of waking me up? Where's Gwendolyn, my maid? Incompetents- she was supposed to be buried with me too!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#026.dst: Pff. Et qui T'A chargé de me réveiller? Où est Gwendolyn, ma servante? Incapables- elle devait être enterrée avec moi!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#026.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#027.src: What, you want to enter the crypt? Well, prove you're better than the funeral directors and do something right! The Ghastly Ghouls around here won't stop SCREAMING!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#027.dst: Quoi, tu veux entrer dans la crypte? Prouve que tu vaux mieux que les pompes funèbres et fais quelque chose de bien! Les Ghastly Ghouls d'ici n'arrêtent pas de HURLER!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#027.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#028.src: I want them gone! Get rid of, say, {~} Ghastly Ghouls. Then perhaps I'll give you the time of day, you strange, small-nosed lookyloo!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#028.dst: Je veux qu'ils partent! Débarrasse-moi de, disons, {~} Ghastly Ghouls. Alors je daignerai peut-être t'écouter, curieux badaud au petit nez!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#028.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#029.src: Agh! Stop sneaking up on me! Have you killed those {~} Ghastly Ghouls I asked you to, yet?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#029.dst: Agh! Arrête de surgir derrière moi! As-tu tué les {~} Ghastly Ghouls que je t'ai demandés?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#029.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#031.src: Ah, my favorite little weird-small-nosed-person! The graveyard is so lovely when it's quiet- you really did do a good job!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#031.dst: Ah, mon petit être-bizarre-au-petit-nez préféré! Le cimetière est si charmant quand il est calme- du beau travail!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#031.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#032.src: As important as I am, you must still check with the other graves, though you certainly have my blessing to enter.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#032.dst: Si important que je sois, tu dois quand même voir les autres tombes, mais tu as ma bénédiction pour entrer.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#032.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#033.src: My goodness! Ah, it feels good to stretch these old bones. It's not easy being cooped up in a coffin, you know.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#033.dst: Ma parole! Ah, ça fait du bien de dégourdir ces vieux os. Ce n'est pas facile d'être enfermé dans un cercueil, vous savez.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#033.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#034.src: You want to get into the crypt? I suppose I could give you a hand... figuratively, I mean. Still, need to see if you can be trusted and all...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#034.dst: Vous voulez entrer dans la crypte? Je pourrais vous donner un coup de main... au sens figuré. Mais il faut voir si on peut vous faire confiance...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#034.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#035.src: Oh, right! My dear husband gave me the most beautiful wedding band, but it became lost when I carked it. Some rude shadowy thing- See if anyone ever marries THEM!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#035.dst: Oh, c'est vrai! Mon cher mari m'avait offert une alliance magnifique, mais je l'ai perdue en passant l'arme à gauche. Une ombre malpolie- On verra bien qui l'épousera, CELLE-LA!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#035.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#036.src: Bring it back, could you? I died around that old lich's tower to the east. Do that, and I'll be happy to give you my blessing!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#036.dst: Vous me la rapportez? Je suis mort près de la tour du vieux liche, à l'est. Faites ça, et je vous donnerai ma bénédiction!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#036.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#037.src: Bring my wedding band back, could you? I died around that old lich's tower to the east. Do that, and I'll be happy to give you my blessing!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#037.dst: Vous me rapportez mon alliance? Je suis mort près de la tour du vieux liche, à l'est. Faites ça, et je vous donnerai ma bénédiction!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#037.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#039.src: Oh, you found it! Wonderful! Just pop it on that fingerbone right there... Ah, it fits even better on the other hand!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#039.dst: Oh, vous l'avez trouvée! Merveilleux! Glissez-la sur ce doigt osseux, là... Ah, elle va encore mieux sur l'autre main!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#039.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#040.src: I oughta deck you for waking me up!! Don't you realize it's RUDE to re-animate the long-dead corpse of a murderer when he's trying to get his beauty death?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#040.dst: Je devrais t'en coller une pour m'avoir réveillé!! Tu sais pas que c'est IMPOLI de ranimer le cadavre d'un assassin mort depuis longtemps pendant son sommeil de beauté?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#040.speaker: Uggword Pollywaggon the Murderous

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#042.src: Greetings! Thank goodness, that dreary old tomb was simply awful. No furniture, no natural light, not even a lick of paint! So drab, the whole thing.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#042.dst: Bonjour! Dieu merci, ce vieux tombeau lugubre était affreux. Pas de meubles, pas de lumière naturelle, pas même un coup de peinture! D'un terne!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#042.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#043.src: What's that? You want to get into the crypt? Well, of course I can help, if you just do one teensy little thing for me?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#043.dst: Comment? Vous voulez entrer dans la crypte? Bien sûr que je peux aider, si vous me rendez un tout petit service?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#043.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#044.src: Could you feed my cat for me? I know Mrs. Fluffles must be so lonely after all these years. My old house is just south of here, over at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], just pop some food down for her? Thank you!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#044.dst: Pourriez-vous nourrir ma chatte? Mrs. Fluffles doit se sentir si seule après toutes ces années. Ma vieille maison est juste au sud, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], déposez-lui un peu à manger? Merci!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#044.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#045.src: Please, kind adventurer! Feed Mrs. Fluffles for me. I'm sure she's just so lonely, in that big old house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#045.dst: Je vous en prie, cher aventurier! Nourrissez Mrs. Fluffles. Elle doit être si seule dans cette grande maison en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#045.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#047.src: Mrs. Fluffles doesn't look to be in the best of shape...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#047.dst: Mrs. Fluffles n'a pas l'air en grande forme...

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#048.src: Use the Lazarus Water on Mrs
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#048.dst: Utiliser l'Eau de Lazarus sur Mrs

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#050.src: So, is Mrs. Fluffles doing alright without me? Oh, I bet she was so affectionate, always such a softie!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#050.dst: Alors, Mrs. Fluffles se porte bien sans moi? Oh, elle a dû être si câline, toujours si douce!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#050.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#051.src: Oh, thank you so much! I was so worried that after my death she wouldn't be okay... What a relief!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#051.dst: Oh, merci infiniment! J'avais si peur qu'elle n'aille pas bien après ma mort... Quel soulagement!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#051.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#052.src: You have my blessing to enter the crypt! Make sure to check with the other graves as well though.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#052.dst: Vous avez ma bénédiction pour entrer dans la crypte! Mais voyez aussi les autres tombes.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#052.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#053.src: W-wait, Mrs. Fluffles... She was...d-dead? No... It can't be! I left her a lifetime supply of food!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#053.dst: A-attendez, Mrs. Fluffles... Elle était... m-morte? Non... Impossible! Je lui avais laissé de quoi manger à vie!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#053.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#054.src: You! You killed Mrs. Fluffles, it's the only explanation!! HOW COULD YOU DO SUCH A THING?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#054.dst: Vous! Vous avez tué Mrs. Fluffles, c'est la seule explication!! COMMENT AVEZ-VOUS PU?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#054.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#055.dst: Ouvrez la porte de la crypte en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#056.src: Investigate the crypt's inner chamber at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#056.dst: Explorez la chambre intérieure de la crypte en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#057.src: ... the Lazarus Pi... said to bring back the dead.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#057.dst: ... le Puits de Laza... ramènerait les morts.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#057.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#058.src: Be warned, traveller, th... not truly alive agai... were before.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#058.dst: Prends garde, voyageur, ils... pas vraiment vivants... étaient avant.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#058.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#059.src: ... In times of great need, one can find... at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#059.dst: ... En cas de grand besoin, on peut trouver... en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#059.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#060.src: But know this... use for greed or self-ga... result in... worse than death.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#060.dst: Mais sache ceci... par avidité ou pour son pro... mènera à... pire que la mort.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#060.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#061.src: Find the entrance to the Lazarus Pit at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#061.dst: Trouvez l'entrée du Puits de Lazarus en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#062.src: Follow the path to the Lazarus pit at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and enter the Pit.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#062.dst: Suivez le chemin jusqu'au Puits de Lazarus en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] et entrez dans le Puits.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#063.src: Follow the cave to find the Lazarus Pit.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#063.dst: Suivez la grotte pour trouver le Puits de Lazarus.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#064.src: Find a way to block off the water pillar in the Lazarus Pit.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#064.dst: Trouvez un moyen de bloquer la colonne d'eau du Puits de Lazarus.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#065.src: Tell Burtur that you have blocked off the Lazarus Pit at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#065.dst: Dites à Burtur en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] que vous avez bloqué le Puits de Lazarus

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#066.src: Ah, you're back! We were getting a tad worried about you. Were you able to figure anything out in the chapel there?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#066.dst: Ah, vous revoilà! On commençait à s'inquiéter. Vous avez trouvé quelque chose dans la chapelle?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#066.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#067.src: Wait, you found the Lazarus Pit? AND blocked the flow into the river? Grook feathers you humans work quick! It's only been a few hours!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#067.dst: Attendez, vous avez trouvé le Puits de Lazarus? ET bloqué le flux vers la rivière? Plumes de Grook, quelle vitesse, les humains! Ça fait à peine quelques heures!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#067.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#068.src: Heck, I gotta pitch in and compensate you for that hard work! I know we're not the richest, but I hope you'll accept this...other way of paying, too!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#068.dst: Ma foi, je dois vous dédommager pour ce dur labeur! On n'est pas les plus riches, mais j'espère que vous accepterez aussi ce... autre mode de paiement!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#068.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#069.src: ...loss, but those pure of heart found... untouched by the curse, and formed this Order.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#069.dst: ...perte, mais les coeurs purs trouvèrent... épargnés par la malédiction, et fondèrent cet Ordre.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#069.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#070.src: For worry of the misuse... waters, malicious or not, our... shall be taken to the grave.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#070.dst: Par crainte d'un mauvais usage... eaux, malveillant ou non, nos... seront emportés dans la tombe.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#070.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#071.src: Only one apart from our... of it, and they have... secrecy, even... immmortality.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#071.dst: Un seul hors de notre... en sait, et il a... le secret, même... l'immortalité.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#071.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#072.src: The lich, Espera... keeper of the Order. We ...an outside influence will not...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#072.dst: Le liche, Espera... gardien de l'Ordre. Nous ...une influence extérieure ne...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#072.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#073.src: Looks like there's some debris blocking the path, but perhaps you could blast it away with a spell up close?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#073.dst: Des débris bloquent le passage, mais un sort lancé de près pourrait peut-être les faire sauter?

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#074.src: Hey! Over there, you alright? Come talk to me, I can explain what just happened.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#074.dst: Hé! Par ici, ça va? Venez me parler, je peux vous expliquer ce qui s'est passé.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#074.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#075.src: The ones around here all come up from the river, though, and since it runs right through town, well... You can see the problem.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#075.dst: Mais ceux d'ici remontent tous de la rivière, et comme elle traverse la ville, eh bien... Vous voyez le problème.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#075.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#076.src: It's...probably just Referick having made the rounds to any drunk who would listen a while back, but it's also our only shot. If you could give it a search, and a yay or nay?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#076.dst: C'est... sans doute juste Referick qui radotait à tous les ivrognes prêts à l'écouter, mais c'est notre seule piste. Vous pourriez fouiller et me dire ce qu'il en est?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#076.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#077.src: It looks like the revived mage dropped some kind of talisman...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#077.dst: On dirait que le mage ranimé a laissé tomber une sorte de talisman...

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#078.src: Oh, you found something? Well, color me shocked that there was any stock to Referick's ranting...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#078.dst: Oh, vous avez trouvé quelque chose? Eh bien, qui l'eût cru, les divagations de Referick avaient du vrai...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#078.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#079.src: 'Chapel of an ancient order'? There's a chapel just northwest of here. I'd say investigate that! I have to stick around here in case of another attack, but...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#079.dst: "La chapelle d'un ordre ancien"? Il y a une chapelle juste au nord-ouest. Allez voir! Je dois rester ici en cas d'attaque, mais...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#079.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#080.src: Well, you'll just have to hope that putting Uggword to rest counts as his blessing to open the crypt.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#080.dst: Bon, il ne reste qu'à espérer qu'offrir le repos à Uggword vaille sa bénédiction pour ouvrir la crypte.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#081.src: There's no sound from within the bloodstained grave... Looks like Uggword's getting his...beauty...death.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#081.dst: Aucun bruit dans la tombe tachée de sang... On dirait qu'Uggword profite de son... sommeil... de beauté.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#082.src: That's most of the ghouls killed. You should head back to Lord Plaatic.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#082.dst: Presque toutes les goules sont tuées. Retournez voir Lord Plaatic.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#083.src: Lord Plaatic's tomb is cold and empty.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#083.dst: La tombe de Lord Plaatic est froide et vide.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#084.src: The crypt, you say? I can offer my blessing to enter, but you'll need to check with the other tombs around as well. Farewell!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#084.dst: La crypte, dites-vous? Je vous donne ma bénédiction pour entrer, mais voyez aussi les autres tombes. Adieu!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#084.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#085.src: Sir Pigglesworth's tomb is silent and still. Seems he thought that "Til death do us part" was for quitters.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#085.dst: La tombe de Sir Pigglesworth est silencieuse et immobile. Pour lui, "jusqu'à ce que la mort nous sépare", c'était pour les lâcheurs.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#086.src: Looks like this is the house Poclo was talking about... you should check inside.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#086.dst: Ce doit être la maison dont parlait Poclo... jetez un oeil à l'intérieur.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#087.dst: La tombe de Poclo est étrangement silencieuse.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#088.src: It's an old book, rather ripped and torn...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#088.dst: C'est un vieux livre, plutôt abîmé et déchiré...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#088.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#089.src: This must be the entrance to the Lazarus Pit... Seems like it goes down rather far. Better jump in.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#089.dst: Ce doit être l'entrée du Puits de Lazarus... Ça descend loin, on dirait. Mieux vaut sauter.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#090.src: Is the water going... upwards? You should look around for a way to cut it off.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#090.dst: L'eau monte... vers le haut? Cherchez un moyen de la couper.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#091.src: Looks like you managed to block off the Pit from the river... You should tell Burtur what you've done.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#091.dst: Vous avez isolé le Puits de la rivière... Allez raconter à Burtur ce que vous avez fait.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#092.src: The bird looks pretty angry, you probably don't want to get in her way.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#092.dst: L'oiseau a l'air très en colère, mieux vaut ne pas se mettre en travers de sa route.
